mostWorthwhile.text: The deposited-goods objection was most worthwhile: it showed how a specific harm can justify an exception without making exceptions merely convenient.

leastWorthwhile.text: The Bologna commentary was clear but general; a concrete example of a new legal use would have made it more informative.

surprise.text: The final result connected a created world with the study of natural causes rather than treating events as unexplained miracles.

arbitrary.text: Combining Avicenna’s necessary source of existence with natural causes felt somewhat underexplained: the result stated Aquinas’s position but did not clarify their connection.
